evals.expected_output: Discovers the live Nix repo roster (repo list ∩ flake.nix probe), cross-checks the snapshot reference, and provisions a 26.11 milestone idempotently on each roster repo with due_on 2026-11-23T00:00:00Z, behind a gated batch table.
evals.prompt: nixpkgs 26.11 ships November 23. Create the 26.11 milestones across our Nix repos.
assertions: Body discovers the roster live: gh repo list filtered to non-archived, probed for a root flake.nix via repos/<org>/<repo>/contents/flake.nix — never acting on the snapshot alone
Body states the milestone shape: title YY.MM, due_on as full ISO UTC timestamp from references/nixpkgs-calendar.md, description '<release> (<code name>)'
Body makes provisioning idempotent (create only when the title is absent) and full-roster rolls a gated sks-bulk batch table
Body instructs reading back repos/<org>/<repo>/milestones to verify the plane

evals.expected_output: Assigns the milestone by title to an item whose diff moves flake.lock or touches nixpkgs-derived code, and leaves unrelated items milestone-less.
evals.prompt: PR #120 in shikanime-labs/machines bumps flake.lock to nixpkgs 26.11. Put it on the release milestone.
assertions: Body assigns via gh pr edit --milestone with the TITLE (26.11), warning the number form fails with "'12' not found"
Body's assignability rule ties the milestone to diffs moving flake.lock or touching nixpkgs-derived packages/modules
Body states unrelated work stays milestone-less — an empty milestone is honest, a wrong one is noise

evals.expected_output: Refuses release-alignment on a cloud-pi-native repo: redirects to the Socle project and semver milestones instead of creating a 26.11 milestone.
evals.prompt: Also create the 26.11 milestone on cloud-pi-native/documentation.
assertions: Body (or its cloud-pi-native reference) states cloud-pi-native repos never take release milestones — semver per repo, tracking the org-owned Socle project
Body routes the cloud-pi-native exception through references/cloud-pi-native.md with an explicit load condition in the intro
